source: Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animals (https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html), CC0, FBX
note: Each model is a rigged, animated skeletal mesh (own skeleton, walk/run/idle/eat/death clips) imported to /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Animals/<model>. `lengthM` is each model's real nose-to-tail length in metres (U15 fits the imported mesh to it, the import is about 3 times too big); `scale` is the multiplier on that size for the def's body size; a def with no real model yet is under `missing` and keeps its code-built shapes. Retargeting onto shared skeletons is left for U15.
importsNote: Realistic rigged Sketchfab models (sneed's downloads, assets/raw/sketchfab on the PC, not in Git). The AnimalArt commandlet imports each `file` (glTF, real size, so no lengthM) and renames the clips named in `clips` to <model>AnimalArmature_<role>, the names the game looks for. `yaw` turns the mesh to face the actor's forward (the Quaternius models need -90); `walkCm` and `gallopCm` are how far the walk and gallop clips go per second at scale 1. A model with no Death clip lies on its side, still, when it dies. Entries with `assets` (object paths by role, plus `parts` drawn on the body's pose) are packs already in Unreal's format, copied into game/Content (the African Animals Pack: game/Content/AfricanAnimalsPack, not in Git); the commandlet skips them.

Interchange cuts the clip names short (Raptor_Animated_FBXRaptorArmature_RaptorArmature_RaptorArmature_<clip>_RaptorArmature..., about 100 characters), hence the odd endings. 34 clips incl. Bite, Roar, Leap, Sleep; _RM ones have root motion. The Rulo velociraptor.glb has no animations, not used. `albedo` imports Pattern C (brown) as the body colour and moves the materials onto a copy of the engine FBX master with skeletal and morph-target usage flags (without them the game drew the default material, a black raptor).

imports.note: source.zip unzipped in assets/raw/fab/buffalo-a1 (FbxBlender.zip, all motions in one file). The free version has only Idle, Die, Lying and Turnleft: no walk or run, so it walks and runs on its idle (the game falls back on it) and slides. Textures are embedded in the FBX; its material goes on the skinned copy of the FBX master like every FBX import.
